description: Edit an API key in place: its label, its access (products or permissions, not both) and its phone-number limit. The secret stays the same. A field left out is left as it is, and at least one must be sent. Narrowing applies at once. Widening (permissions the key lacks, numbers it is not limited to, or lifting its number limit) needs a step-up token this server cannot send, so it answers 403 PERMISSION_ESCALATION (widen in the dashboard); a team member may widen only keys they created. Dashboard session keys and keys an OAuth connection holds cannot be edited (409 CONFLICT).

account_id.description: Your account ID. Omit it and it is resolved from your API key.

key_id.description: The API key record ID to edit (from get_account api_keys list).

permissions.description: Per-resource permissions: each key is a resource name (messages, phone_numbers, contacts, contact_groups, lists, compliance, webhooks, verify, account, api_keys, emails, email_domains, email_suppressions, email_templates, push, push_devices, recipients, notifications, auth_apps, auth_users, auth_organizations), each value a string of allowed operations (r=read, w=write, m=modify, d=delete). Omit a resource to deny it. Omit this whole field to default to the calling key's own permissions. A key can only be created with permissions the calling key itself holds.

phone_number_ids.description: Limit the key to these phone numbers (ids from list_phone_numbers, not released): it sends SMS and Verify only from them and reads only their messages, verifications and opt-outs. Such a key may hold only the sms, verify and webhooks products (422 otherwise). null: no number limit. Omit it: a new key inherits the calling key's limit, if any, and an edit leaves the limit as it is.

products.description: Make a product key: it holds the permissions of these products (sms, verify, email, push, notify, auth, webhooks). Send this or permissions, not both (422).
